evidence: Parsed every file with tomllib (in memory, -B). scoring.toml = {gates:{render:0.0,constraints:0.0}, weights:{functional:0.6,polish:0.2,visual:0.2} (sum 1.0), floors:{functional:0.05}}, byte-identical in content to the template; every name has its directory (tests/gates/render, tests/gates/constraints, tests/scored/functional|polish|visual). All five judge.toml: [judge] judge='claude-code' (matches task.toml REWARDKIT_JUDGE), mode='batched', isolated=false, prompt_template='prompt.md', timeouts 600/600/9000/900/900; no model/reasoning_effort/temperature/weight keys in [judge] (extra-key set empty); top-level keys only judge/scoring/criterion (no trialforge files/target_claims). Each has exactly the template playwright server (stdio, command playwright-mcp, args --headless --isolated --executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium --no-sandbox). Only scored/functional/judge.toml:14-18 adds the 'verifier' server: command /usr/local/bin/python3, args ['/tests/tools/restart_mcp.py', '$APP_RESTART_HELPER']; test.sh:193 'export APP_RESTART_HELPER="$LOG_DIR/app-restart.sh"' after heredoc+sed+chmod 755, before run_suite gates (213) and scored (224). tests/test.sh, tools/score.py, tools/restart_mcp.py, Dockerfile, .dockerignore are identical to the frozen template (diff -q). restart_mcp.py exposes single-use 'restart_app'; functional prompt line 1 and protocol D (line 51) call it once; only criterion hro_restart references restart; polish/visual prompts never reference it. Aggregation: gates all_pass, scored weighted_mean. Criteria: constraints 1 (hro_gate_shared, binary), render 1 (hro_gate_render, binary) - gates binary-only; functional 44 binary (ids unique, id==name, weights 0.5-2.5 positive, total 59.5, descriptions non-empty); polish 5 binary (total 12); visual 5 likert points=5 weight 1.2 each with 1-5 anchors present. Prompt resolution: each prompt.md exists beside its judge.toml and contains exactly the placeholders {app_context} and {criteria}; test.sh:195-201 replaces {app_context} from /tests/app_context.md in /tests/*/*/prompt.md; no stray braces elsewhere in prompts or judge.toml descriptions. Every protocol letter used as a criterion prefix in functional (S,M,L,R,N,K,T,C,B,A,V,Z,U,D) is defined in scored/functional/prompt.md lines 25-51. No CRLF in any tests file. score.py reads gates/reward.json and scored/reward.json keyed by scoring.toml names, matching run_suite output paths. Adversarial: (a) broken app passing via wiring - not possible structurally: both gates are binary all_pass at 0.0, score.py zeroes reward on gate failure and skips scored, functional floor 0.05 blocks farming polish/visual; (b) conforming app failing via wiring - restart helper path/export and placeholder substitution are the unchanged template mechanism and the functional server is the only restart path; no structural cause found. Limits: this is source/parse evidence. raw-evidence-index.json states full configured grading is absent, so RewardKit 0.1.7 actually loading these files, expanding $APP_RESTART_HELPER, and the Playwright MCP (0.0.79) exposing browser_run_code_unsafe named in prompts were not exercised this round; tool-name feasibility belongs to the tool-feasibility rows, and the wiring itself is the template mechanism.
